name: compute-expert
description: Judgement for Compute with Lineage (TDA_Compute): when to compute over rows versus let the query aggregate, which operation states what the question asked, how to read a receipt, and how to present a computed figure so its lineage survives into the answer.
author: Uderia
use_cases: Deciding whether a total belongs in the SQL (GROUP BY, SUM) or in a compute step over the rows
Choosing the operation that states what was asked (rank vs filter, pct_change vs diff)
Presenting a computed figure exactly as receipted, with what it was computed over
Recovering from a refusal that names several numeric columns
Reading a receipt's rows-used against the row count to spot NULL-riddled measures
